race.comment: DALI'S PICASSO (2) has been racing in great heart with two top-three finishes on end, the latest a third over 1550m at Mt Gambier. Finds a similar race and Kayla Crowther on aids the cause. WILLEBOB (7) showed good early speed from the inside draw last time and stalked the lead before fading to finish fourth over 1400m at Balaklava. Still lightly raced and can give a sight. NEVER PEGASUS (6) could only manage to finish fourth, beaten 3.5 lengths, at his latest appearance over 1050m at Balaklava. Only having his fourth career run and maps for every hope. STEPIFY (12) should be poised to run a big race first up from a spell following three recent trials. Must be respected.
